providers.name: OpenAI
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Use the approved OpenAI account, region and enterprise data controls for the tenant.
providers.configurationNote: Set OPENAI_API_KEY and choose an enabled model through AIW_LLM_* configuration.

providers.name: xAI Grok
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Confirm the organization data policy and region before routing confidential architecture material.
providers.configurationNote: xAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Set XAI_API_KEY and an explicit model.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Select the approved Google AI or Vertex AI tenancy and region for enterprise workloads.
providers.configurationNote: Gemini supports OpenAI-compatible access; use a model enabled in the configured Google account.

providers.name: Alibaba Qwen
providers.dataBoundaryNote: The endpoint is region-specific. Choose the approved Model Studio workspace and deployment region.
providers.configurationNote: Set AIW_LLM_QWEN_BASE_URL because Model Studio endpoints vary by region and workspace.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Confirm enterprise data-processing and regional requirements before sending non-public material.
providers.configurationNote: DeepSeek provides an OpenAI-compatible API. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and an explicit current model.

providers.name: Custom OpenAI-compatible service
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Governance depends on the configured service owner, hosting model and network boundary.
providers.configurationNote: AIW_CUSTOM_LLM_BASE_URL and model are mandatory. Secrets must remain outside project data.

providers.name: Local OpenAI-compatible service
providers.dataBoundaryNote: Suitable for private deployment when the local model and infrastructure have been approved.
providers.configurationNote: Use an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint such as an internally operated model gateway.
